events.name: session_started
events.meaning: A play session of this install began (emitted once consent >= local).
events.notes: Not emitted before consent: the first launch prompt answer triggers it.

events.name: session_interrupted
events.meaning: The connection to the host was lost for good or refused after joining.
events.notes: Only terminal outcomes; reconnect flip-flops are debounced.

events.name: lobby_created
events.notes: Needs the HostLineController call site.

events.name: lobby_join_attempted
events.notes: kind is manual unless ClientTelemetry.NoteJoinKind said otherwise (auto = -autojoin launch arg).

events.name: lobby_joined
events.meaning: The client is connected to a lobby.

events.name: lobby_join_failed
events.meaning: A join or rejoin ended in failure.
events.notes: Other reject.* reasons are reported as net.connect_failed.

events.name: player_ready_changed
events.meaning: A seat changed its ready flag.
events.notes: Clock = telemetry monotonic clock (lobby has no engine time).

events.name: match_started
events.notes: lobby_fill_seconds = lobby created to last seat joined; ready_seconds = all ready to start (omitted when not observed).

events.name: match_start_failed
events.notes: Unknown reason keys map to engine_error.

events.name: match_abandoned
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.meaning: Fewer than 2 players stayed connected; the engine abandoned the match.

events.name: rematch_requested
events.trigger: Scripts/Telemetry/ClientTelemetry.cs ClientTelemetry.RematchRequested via UI: Scripts/UI/Meeting/WeekResultsView.cs (Play again)

events.name: rematch_started
events.meaning: A new match began from the same lobby.
events.notes: Needs the HostLineController call site.

events.name: week_started
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.notes: days from engine view, tasks = Company.TasksScheduled.

events.name: day_started
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)

events.name: phase_entered
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.notes: planned = engine.PhaseEndTime - phase start (omitted when the engine already moved on).

events.name: phase_exited
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.meaning: A phase ended (actual vs planned duration, why).
events.notes: completion_reason from PhaseChanged.B.

events.name: phone_call_connected
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)

events.name: phone_call_rejected
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.notes: Never counts as participation.

events.name: phone_call_missed
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.meaning: Nobody answered (ring timeout or caller hung up).
events.notes: Never counts as participation.

events.name: phone_call_failed
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.notes: Rejected Apply() results (PhoneDead, Absent, WrongPhase) are not visible as engine events; only CallBusy/MissedCall/CallEnded are observed.

events.name: phone_call_finished
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.notes: censored = ended by disconnect, telemetry stop or match end (duration is a lower bound).

events.name: phone_round_summary
events.availability_note: v5 gameplay observer not implemented yet (the v4 LineTelemetryObserver was removed with the v4 rules in v5 Phase 1)
events.meaning: Per task phone usage of observed players.
events.notes: participation = observed players with >= 1 successful connected call overlapping the task window / observed. rate omitted when observed = 0 (not_measured).

events.name: secret_info_presented
